_meta.note: Snapshot of real NVD records for well-documented CVEs historically exploited at each MITRE ATT&CK stage this project forecasts. Cached locally (not a live API call) so the dashboard runs fully offline, same as the rest of this project's demo path. See models/cve_lookup.py for the scope caveat on what this mapping does and does not claim.

reconnaissance.description: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability ("ProxyLogon") -- an SSRF flaw mass-scanned for and used to fingerprint vulnerable Exchange servers ahead of exploitation.

initial_access.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookup remote code execution ("Log4Shell") -- unauthenticated, network-exploitable, one of the most widely used initial-access vectors ever recorded.

lateral_movement.description: Netlogon elevation of privilege ("Zerologon") -- lets an attacker who has landed on the internal network impersonate a domain controller and pivot with domain admin rights.

command_and_control.description: Citrix ADC/Gateway directory traversal -- widely exploited to drop web shells and establish a persistent, remotely-controllable foothold (C2) on the appliance.

exfiltration.description: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL injection -- exploited at mass scale in 2023 to directly access and exfiltrate database contents from managed file-transfer deployments.

impact.description: Kubernetes API server privilege escalation via crafted proxied upgrade requests -- lets an attacker send arbitrary commands to backend services, used for high-impact disruption of cluster workloads.
